rationale: Sanvith is advancing reasoning capabilities in AI systems at Reasoning Company, while Kaushik brings hands-on ML and robotics expertise from Mytra with deep experience in autonomous systems and embedded programming. They can explore how advanced reasoning architectures might enhance robotics and autonomous systems applications, combining Sanvith's AI research focus with Kaushik's practical implementation experience in Python and C++.
intro_message: Sanvith Reddy Munagala, meet Kaushik Prakash — you're both working at the intersection of advanced AI and robotics; Kaushik's autonomous systems background at Mytra could be valuable context as Reasoning Company develops reasoning capabilities.
